maya: Quick heads-up — hitting a long-context regression on the new opt-3b-quant4x bring-up. Repro steps and short logs below. Suspect RoPE scaling interacting with tiled KV indices. cc @linus @olivia

linus: Can you paste minimal repro and config? Which quant profile (int4v2 / quant4x / int8)?

maya: quant4x, shards=2, seq_len=12288 run with kv_cache enabled, priming pattern is anchored repeats (same 512-token anchor repeated every 2k). Test id: LR-2026-042. Command:```python ./serve_eval.py --model opt-3b --quant-profile quant4x --shards 2 --seq 12288 --kv-cache on --priming anchored_repeat```

olivia: I saw a similar token-shift in nightly perf — divergence usually shows up around 4k-6k tokens when we use tiled shards, could be wraparound on the index floor.

sam: Repro'd locally on a single-card int4 sim (quant4x emulate) — divergence at step 5120. Short diff: expected phrase "the quick brown fox jumps" vs got "the quick bro
 n fox jumps" (extra newline / token split).

maya: logs snippet:```
[2026-03-18 14:12:07] step=5100 kv_idx=5100 req_token=\"brown\" kv_map_hash=0x7f9a4
[2026-03-18 14:12:07] step=5120 kv_idx=5120 req_token=\"\u000a\" cache_lookup=HIT
[2026-03-18 14:12:07] mismatch at kv_slot=5120: expected=0x62('b') got=0x0a('\n')
```

devbot: deploy-bot: Canary deploy opt-3b-quant4x-2026-03-18-11:45 started -> rolled back (healthcheck failures)

linus: Quick experiments to try: 1) force rotary/phase scale to 1.0 for priming region (phase_scale=1.0) 2) disable KV prefetch/prefill to rule out prefill stride bugs 3) run with pad_mode=none (no quant packing padding).

maya: Running phase_scale=1.0 + kv_prefill=false now on shard=2. ETA ~20m. If stable, I'll add a deterministic test in kvcache/tests that primes with repeated anchors.

olivia: Also try with smaller tile size (tile_kv=256) — we've seen stride interactions before when tile size mismatches quant packing.

sam: Re-run results: with phase_scale=1.0 divergence not observed up to 12k tokens in 3 runs. With kv_prefill=false also clean. culprit likely RoPE scaling + prefill stride collision. Saving traces to /mnt/artifacts/LR-2026-042/trace.json and creating ticket RL-613 with sample trace and diff.

maya: Nice. I'll open a tiny PR that adds a failing test (priming repeat case) and a runtime guard to avoid using accelerated phase scaling for anchored priming until we have a fix. @sam can you attach minimal trace to the RL-613 ticket?

sam: On it, trace uploaded and ticket created: https://redwood-internal/rl/613 TL;DR attached.

maya: :thumbsup: Thanks all. If PR lands I'll write a short postmortem with root cause hypothesis + mitigation (disable accelerated phase scaling for repeated anchors).

linus: If this is confirmed, also add a small eval to the long-context benchmark CI to run anchored-repeat for 12k tokens so we catch regressions early.

maya: Will do. Closing loop after PR + CI job.
